map.：点声源声功率 P，距离 r1 处 I1=P/(4πr1²)；r2=2r1 处: : A point source with sound power P: at distance r1 the intensity is I1 = P/(4*pi*r1^2); at r2 = 2r1 the intensity is I2 = P/(4*pi*r2^2) = I1/4, so the intensity falls to one quarter, corresponding to a 6 dB drop in sound pressure level.
map.为什么距离加倍降 6 dB？: Why does doubling the distance drop 6 dB?
map.声强与距离平方成反比，能量扩散到 4 倍面积，10·log10(1/4)≈−6: Sound intensity is inversely proportional to the square of distance; the energy spreads over 4 times the area, and 10*log10(1/4) is about -6 dB.
map.反平方定律何时不成立？: When does the inverse square law fail?
map.仅在自由场、点源、无反射吸收时成立；室内混响场中衰减更慢。: It holds only in a free field with a point source and no reflection or absorption; in an indoor reverberant field attenuation is slower.
